metaDescription: Wholesale Custom Dual-Plated Gold & Silver Challenge Coins (Solid Brass, $1.75–$3.65/pc). MOQ 50 pcs, custom mold waived on bulk, 12h free proof.
overview: Custom Dual-Plated Gold & Silver Challenge Coins is custom-manufactured to order in our Zhongshan Xiaolan hardware facility using Solid Brass / Zinc Alloy (Ø44.5×3.5mm (1.75"), 46g) via Hand-Masked Two-Tone Dual Electroplating. Available in Antique Silver + Shiny Gold Masking with PVC Pouch / Clear Acrylic Capsule, starting at 50 pcs MOQ with 12-hour free digital proofs, 12–15 Days production lead time, and factory-direct pricing from $1.75 to $3.65/pc.

specs.Compliance & Safety: US CPSIA Lead (<90 ppm), CA Prop 65 & EU REACH / EN 1811

features: Precision Solid Brass / Zinc Alloy Craftsmanship: Produced via Hand-Masked Two-Tone Dual Electroplating with tight dimensional control (Ø44.5×3.5mm (1.75"), 46g).
Versatile Electroplating & Finishing: Available in Antique Silver + Shiny Gold Masking with custom Pantone color matching.
Flexible Tooling Economics: $120 Dual-Tone Die (Waived @ 1k), plus complimentary 3-year steel mold archiving for zero-fee reorders.
Turnkey Retail & Event Readiness: Ships with PVC Pouch / Clear Acrylic Capsule, optional custom backing cards, velvet gift boxes, and full DDP air/sea logistics.

faqs.question: What is the minimum order quantity (MOQ) and unit price for Custom Dual-Plated Gold & Silver Challenge Coins?
faqs.answer: The starting wholesale MOQ for Custom Dual-Plated Gold & Silver Challenge Coins is 50 pcs. Reference factory-direct tiered pricing is $3.65/pc (50 pcs starter tier), $2.35/pc (500 pcs tier), and $1.75/pc (2,000+ pcs volume tier), depending on size and finish complexity.

faqs.question: What is the mold or tooling fee for Custom Dual-Plated Gold & Silver Challenge Coins, and when is it waived?
faqs.answer: Tooling policy for Custom Dual-Plated Gold & Silver Challenge Coins is $120 Dual-Tone Die (Waived @ 1k). Every client receives custom steel tooling cut strictly to their artwork, stored free of charge for 3 years in our Zhongshan mold vault so subsequent reorders pay $0 mold fees.

faqs.question: What base materials and manufacturing crafts are used on Custom Dual-Plated Gold & Silver Challenge Coins?
faqs.answer: Custom Dual-Plated Gold & Silver Challenge Coins is custom-engineered from Solid Brass / Zinc Alloy using Hand-Masked Two-Tone Dual Electroplating, sized around Ø44.5×3.5mm (1.75") at approximately 46g per unit (custom dimensions available).

faqs.question: Which electroplating colors and surface finishes are available for Custom Dual-Plated Gold & Silver Challenge Coins?
faqs.answer: Standard factory surface options for this custom craft include Antique Silver + Shiny Gold Masking. Dual-tone masking plating and custom matte or clear protective lacquer coatings are also available upon request.

faqs.question: What backings, attachments, and accessories come with Custom Dual-Plated Gold & Silver Challenge Coins?
faqs.answer: This custom format ships with PVC Pouch / Clear Acrylic Capsule. Upgrade hardware options such as deluxe locking pin clutches, magnetic no-hole bar clasps, custom split rings, or velvet presentation boxes can be specified in your quote.

faqs.question: Can we get a free digital artwork proof before paying for tooling or samples?
faqs.answer: Yes. Send your vector logo (.AI, .EPS, .SVG, or vector .PDF) or rough sketch via our quote form or WhatsApp, and our engineering team will send a free 1:1 scaled digital production proof within 12 hours.

faqs.question: Can we order a physical pre-production sample of Custom Dual-Plated Gold & Silver Challenge Coins before mass production?
faqs.answer: Yes. Pre-production physical samples take 7–10 business days (paid sample covers custom mold cutting to your design, plating, and enamel finishing; courier air freight is billed at carrier cost or via your DHL/FedEx account).

faqs.question: What is the bulk production lead time for Custom Dual-Plated Gold & Silver Challenge Coins?
faqs.answer: Mass production for Custom Dual-Plated Gold & Silver Challenge Coins completes in 12–15 Days after digital artwork proof or physical sample approval, followed by multi-point pre-shipment inspection for color accuracy, plating luster, and attachment security.

faqs.question: Does Custom Dual-Plated Gold & Silver Challenge Coins meet US CPSIA, California Prop 65, and EU REACH safety standards?
faqs.answer: Yes. All raw metals, electroplating baths, and Pantone enamel pigments comply with US CPSIA (<90 ppm lead), California Prop 65, and EU REACH / EN 1811 nickel-release regulations.

faqs.question: What retail packaging upgrades are compatible with Custom Dual-Plated Gold & Silver Challenge Coins?
faqs.answer: Beyond complimentary individual polybags, Custom Dual-Plated Gold & Silver Challenge Coins can be packaged onto custom printed 350gsm retail backing cards, sealed inside clear acrylic coin capsules, or presented in flocked velvet gift boxes.
